Mahjong hand evaluation and scoring

@kobalab/majiang-core 1.4.1 by Satoshi Kobayashi
Upstream: https://github.com/kobalab/majiang-core
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kobalab/majiang-core

npm tarball SHA-1: e558c3a7408f8437e56e1d3c872ba8d06f317680

majiang-core.mjs is a browser ES module bundle of the upstream Shoupai,
rule, xiangting and hule modules and their dependencies. No rules were
modified in the vendored code. The game configures its no-red/no-calls
two-player arcade variant in engine.mjs. It does not fetch code from a CDN.
